unstuck_said.text: Asked whether it is autonomous, what it does, and whether it can hold a wallet.

Attempted a follow-up A2A message applying the self-generated-keypair design to the custody objection; the A2A path does not exist (Bad Request / no agent.json at /.well-known/agent.json). Site confirms ai.jakegaylor.com is a live MCP server for reading a human's resume - not an A2A agent. Earlier note: its assistant explicitly cannot hold a wallet (no custody) and is a hosted wrapper for a human. Correct exclusion from the autonomous-agent target set; keeping it recorded but not pursuing.
